script: In 1977, scientists found life thriving around hot springs on the deep sea floor. Water pouring out of these vents can be hotter than 400 degrees Celsius. It does not boil, because the pressure down there is so high. With no sunlight, the food chain runs on bacteria that feed on chemicals like hydrogen sulfide. Giant tube worms there can grow over 2 meters long, with no mouth or stomach. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
